name: tou_vacation_cool_bank_surfaces_1404

assertions.reason: First classified cycle inside the bank window: the thermostat is told the bank target 80°F once (Issues #1393/#1395 unchanged by #1404).
Nothing is written between cycles (the bank write cancels the 5-minute follow-up; the bank check sees the thermostat holds it).
The next cycle re-asserts the bank target once.

The heat/cool thresholds (ca_target_heat/cool, the Heat/Cool Threshold sensors, the reading card's 'Climate Advisor wants') quote the bank: the cool edge is 80°F, what the thermostat is told (issue #1404).
The threshold sensors' context names the time-of-use bank.
The chart draws the same band the thresholds quote (issue #1404).

assertions.value: pre-cooling to 80°F until the 4:15 PM high-cost period, then the Vacation band widened to 57–86°F until 9:00 PM
assertions.reason: Status says what the house is held to, until when, and the band that follows.

description: Issue #1404 (Vacation cool): a house on vacation on a hot day with a 16:15-21:00 peak (Vacation band 57-83 F). The split-delta bank tells the thermostat cool 80 F. Before the fix Status, the thresholds and the briefing quoted cool 83 F, so the reading card said 'Climate Advisor wants 83 F' while CA cooled to 80 F.

verdict.summary: While a vacation house pre-cools for a peak, every surface says it is held to 80 F and when the widened Vacation band takes over
verdict.observed_behavior: The thermostat is told 80°F once per cycle; Status, the thresholds, the briefing, the chart band, Next Action, Next Automation and the plan list all quote 80°F and the band that follows.
verdict.expected_behavior: Occupant view: the person can read on any surface what the house is held to during the bank and when it goes back.
verdict.effectiveness: Fails on 6ebdb16 (before #1404): Next Action and Next Automation differ by value; the hold.* rows fail because 6ebdb16 has no current_hold (its thresholds quoted the schedule band, e.g. 66/78, and the chart drew the #786 shape). Deleting the display resolver (current_hold) fails every field_equals here; the setpoint_writes rows pin that the thermostat writes did not change.
verdict.alignment: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md (time-of-use bank, Issue #1404 paragraph) and docs/scheduler-spec.md describe the same hold sentence and band.
verdict.user_outcome: If this regressed, the person on vacation would read a band the thermostat is not told (e.g. 'Climate Advisor wants 83 F' while it cools to 80 F) and could not tell what the house is held to or when it goes back.
